scope: Multiple unconditional final JSON_VALUE/JSON_EXISTS/IS JSON/JSON_QUERY readers over direct character fields or literals. architecture: Calc collects compatible direct reader inputs, applies a JSON-free filter, and acquires Jackson recycler metadata once per nonempty batch. A UTF-16-length schedule supplies each kernel the capacity at its row/projection position and publishes the final capacity once. Ordinary short documents avoid per-row tables and UTF-16 scans. TLS scope clears during normal completion and unwinding. Documents/results never enter a JVM JSON evaluator.
